description: Hear how much of your Claude plan you have used: the 5 hour limit, the weekly limit and any per-model weekly limit, with reset times. Press twice for full details, or copy them to the clipboard. No keys are assigned by default; set them in Input Gestures under Claude Usage. Uses your Claude Code login. Nothing runs in the background.
changelog: First public release. Speak your Claude plan usage, show full details, or copy them. Every press checks fresh. When the server asks you to wait, the add-on says how long and gives your last numbers.
